reviews.comment: I wanted to give her a chance because I was interested in the reading but I couldn't hang. I'm all for going to class and getting the most out of college but her attendance policy is truly extreme (minus 2 points from FINAL grade avg. for unexcused absences). If you're worried that you'll accidentally sleep through class, I would not recommend.

Online course graded by 4 "block" projects. 1-2 discussion posts per week but were not that bad. She let us have creative freedom for each project so I found myself really enjoying this class. If you put effort into the projects it's not hard to make an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Graded the papers extremely harshly and provided little feedback. It seemed that nothing I turned in was ever good enough, and I usually make A's on all of my papers. I tried to participate each class, but my participation grade was still so low that it affected my grade negatively. She nitpicked every assignment but did nothing to help students.

This professor is awful. She assigned multiple papers throughout the semester, had unclear due dates, and was an extremely harsh grader. I worked so hard on every single assignment, attended her office hours, and went to the writing center. I would receive grades anywhere from high Cs to low As. Also, she takes forever to grade assignments.

Very strict about attendance and participation. doesn't seem to have grading guidelines, just merely gives you the grade she thinks you deserve with little to no explanation. hardly gives any feedback, and when she does it's  passive-aggressive. made everything more difficult than it needed to be. if you hate public speaking, definitely avoid.

very hard grader but doesn't any grade distribution adjustments. never missed a class and tried to talk each class but got a 67 on participation which dropped my grade a whole letter. never gives 100s on any assignment and doesn't seem like anything her students turn in will be good enough

Do not take this professor. The grading in this class does not feel structured at all. It feels like she takes your grades and bases your score on whatever she thinks so its hard to know what to do to get a good grade. Often she would score my assignments and give me the rubric after she graded my assignment. Very annoying.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters
